page.layout: Running head and page number at top; below, one text block of Latin verse and prose in a main column, with marginal notes (references and short citations) down the left margin, interleaved with the lines they stand beside. Two headings in the text (place names) and a catchword at the foot right.

main_text.head: Rhodus Insula maris Ægæi.

p.i: Ex aduerso autem ora
Ægyptia Rhodus est, Ialysiorum solum hominum.
Hanc autem post Orientem versus Chelidoniæ sunt
Tres insulæ, magnum Patareum intra promontorium.
Laudabunt alij claram Rhodon, aut Myrlenem.
Roma laudetur Samos, & Chios, & Rhodos absens.
— contempto mallet Rhodos aspera Phœbo.

main_text.head: Cyprus insula maris Ægæi, vltima ad Orien- tem in sinu Pamphylio, quem alij Ifsicum vocant.

p.i: Cyprus autem ortum versus, Pamphylium intra sinum Alluitur, amabilis vrbs Dionæa Veneris.
Juxta vero Phœnicen Aradus vasto in mari.
Sic te diuapotens Cypri.
— genitor tum Belus opimam
Vastabat Cyprum, & victor ditione tenebat.
Sardonios habitare sinus, & inhospita Cypri
Saxa parant, vitámque freto spumante tueri.
Tunc Cilicum liquere solum, Cypróque citatas Immisere rates, nullas cui pratulit aras
Unda diua memor Paphia, si numina nasci Credimus aut quenquam fas est cœpisse deorum.

main_text.head: Paphos vrbs Cypri insulæ.

p.i: Nō secus Alma Venus, quàm si Papho æquore ab alto Idaliáfque domos, Ericinâque templa subiret.
O Venus regina Gnidi, Paphique,
Sperne dilectam Cypron: & vocanti
Turete multo Glycera decoram Transfer in aedem.
Capta viri forma, non iam Cythereia curat
Littora,
